1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the cooling system is __specifically configured for installation between studs spaced at standard wall framing intervals__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, __and wherein the system is designed for installation in residential or commercial structures__.

5. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, __and the cooled air is directed into an interior space of the structure__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation, __and the system includes a water recirculation loop__.

8. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Original) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements __including fasteners for securing the housing between wall studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Original) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing configured for mounting within a structure wall, the housing containing an evaporative cooling apparatus for cooling an indoor area__.

18. (Cancelled)

19. (Original) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Original) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for enclosing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
